audit_metadata.audit_title: Hybrid Feature Provenance and Temporal Cutoff Audit

round_1_points_reset_verified.note: Proves cumulative championship standings reset to exactly 0 before Round 1.

target_excluded_from_features.note: Target column won_race is strictly excluded from the 42 model features.

weather_provenance_verified.note: All weather variables are prefixed 'quali_', confirming they reflect Saturday qualifying sessions, not race conditions.

candidate_2025_r1_points_reset.note: Candidate 2025 dataset honors strict season initialization.

grid_position.raw_source: FIA Official Starting Grid Document / Jolpica QualifyingResults/Results grid
grid_position.transformation: Integer position (1-20). Pit-lane starters assigned position 20 or subsequent pit-lane order.
grid_position.missing_data_imputation: Fallback to quali_position if official grid unreleased (Stage A)
grid_position.availability_timestamp: Sunday ~2-3 hours before race start (Stage B); Saturday ~2 hours post-quali (Stage A provisional)

model_feature_grid_position.raw_source: Derived from official starting grid and pit-lane status
model_feature_grid_position.transformation: Capped numerical index (1-20) preserving true track starting box or pit lane penalty order

quali_position.transformation: Final classification rank in qualifying session (1-20)

grid_penalty_delta.raw_source: Derived from FIA grid document vs qualifying classification
grid_penalty_delta.transformation: Signed integer delta representing net grid drop or promotion
grid_penalty_delta.missing_data_imputation: 0.0 at Stage A (provisional); computed at Stage B

quali_time_delta_to_pole.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying lap times (Q1, Q2, Q3)
quali_time_delta_to_pole.transformation: Positive continuous gap in seconds to pole position time. 0.0 for pole sitter.
quali_time_delta_to_pole.missing_data_imputation: Median imputation for drivers without timed laps

quali_time_ratio_to_pole.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying lap times (Q1, Q2, Q3)

reached_q3.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if qualified in top 10 / participated in Q3, 0.0 otherwise)

front_row.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if starting P1 or P2, 0.0 otherwise)
front_row.availability_timestamp: Sunday ~2-3 hours pre-race (Stage B); Saturday provisional (Stage A)

driver_prev_race_position.transformation: Finishing position in immediately preceding championship round
driver_prev_race_position.missing_data_imputation: Median imputation (20.0 for debutants / season openers)

driver_prev_race_points.transformation: Championship points scored in round R-1

driver_rolling_3_avg_finish.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-3 to R-1
driver_rolling_3_avg_finish.transformation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of finishing position over prior 3 completed starts

driver_rolling_5_avg_finish.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_avg_finish.transformation: Mean finishing position over prior 5 starts

driver_rolling_5_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_win_rate.transformation: Proportion of wins across last 5 completed starts (0.0 to 1.0)

driver_rolling_5_podium_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_podium_rate.transformation: Proportion of podiums across last 5 completed starts

driver_rolling_5_pts_per_race.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_pts_per_race.transformation: Average points scored per race over last 5 completed starts

driver_rolling_5_dnf_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_dnf_rate.transformation: Proportion of non-finishes due to mechanical or accident causes

driver_rolling_10_avg_finish.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-10 to R-1
driver_rolling_10_avg_finish.transformation: Mean finish position over last 10 starts

driver_rolling_10_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results for rounds R-10 to R-1
driver_rolling_10_win_rate.transformation: Proportion of wins across last 10 starts

driver_season_points_before_gp.transformation: Total cumulative championship points entering the race weekend (0.0 for Round 1)

driver_season_standing_before_gp.transformation: Championship ranking entering round R (1 to 20+; tied at 20 for Round 1)

constructor_prev_race_points.transformation: Points scored by the team in the preceding round

constructor_rolling_3_avg_points.raw_source: Jolpica Results rounds R-3 to R-1
constructor_rolling_3_avg_points.transformation: Average constructor points scored across prior 3 completed rounds

constructor_rolling_5_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results rounds R-5 to R-1
constructor_rolling_5_win_rate.transformation: Team win rate across prior 5 completed rounds

constructor_rolling_5_podium_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results rounds R-5 to R-1
constructor_rolling_5_podium_rate.transformation: Proportion of last 5 races where team achieved at least one podium

constructor_rolling_3_avg_grid.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying results rounds R-3 to R-1
constructor_rolling_3_avg_grid.transformation: Mean starting/qualifying position across both cars in prior 3 rounds

constructor_season_points_before_gp.transformation: Cumulative constructor points entering round R (0.0 for Round 1)

constructor_season_standing_before_gp.transformation: Constructor championship rank entering round R (1 to 10; tied at 10 for Round 1)

constructor_best_quali_delta_to_pole.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying session of target GP
constructor_best_quali_delta_to_pole.transformation: Fastest qualifying gap to pole achieved by either driver of the team in target GP

outqualified_teammate.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying results of target GP
outqualified_teammate.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if qualified ahead of teammate, 0.0 otherwise)

teammate_rolling_5_quali_h2h.raw_source: Jolpica Qualifying results rounds R-5 to R-1
teammate_rolling_5_quali_h2h.transformation: Proportion of prior 5 qualifying sessions where driver beat teammate (0.0 to 1.0)

driver_circuit_starts.raw_source: Jolpica historical race starts at current circuit_id prior to target year
driver_circuit_starts.transformation: Total previous career race starts at this venue

driver_circuit_wins.raw_source: Jolpica historical race results at current circuit_id prior to target year
driver_circuit_wins.transformation: Total career Grand Prix victories at this venue

driver_circuit_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica historical starts/wins at current circuit
driver_circuit_win_rate.transformation: Historical win rate at venue (0.0 if 0 starts)

driver_circuit_podiums.raw_source: Jolpica historical results at current circuit
driver_circuit_podiums.transformation: Total career podiums at this venue

driver_circuit_avg_finish.raw_source: Jolpica historical results at current circuit
driver_circuit_avg_finish.transformation: Mean finish position at this circuit (excluding current GP)

constructor_circuit_wins.raw_source: Jolpica historical constructor results at current circuit
constructor_circuit_wins.transformation: Total team victories at this venue prior to target GP

circuit_historical_pole_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica historical pole conversion rate at current circuit
circuit_historical_pole_win_rate.transformation: Empirical pole conversion probability at circuit across all historical F1 GPs

is_sprint_weekend.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if weekend includes Sprint session, 0.0 for standard format)

quali_air_temp_c.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying session
quali_air_temp_c.transformation: Mean ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius during Saturday Qualifying

quali_track_temp_c.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying session
quali_track_temp_c.transformation: Mean track surface temperature in degrees Celsius during Saturday Qualifying

quali_humidity_pct.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying session
quali_humidity_pct.transformation: Mean relative humidity percentage during Saturday Qualifying

quali_rainfall.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying session
quali_rainfall.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if rain detected during Saturday Qualifying, 0.0 dry)

P_ML_Model_B.raw_source: Remediated LightGBM Model B trained on 2021-2023 data
P_ML_Model_B.missing_data_imputation: Uniform prior fallback if inference fails
P_ML_Model_B.availability_timestamp: Sunday ~2 hours before race start (Stage B)

P_grid_Empirical_Baseline.raw_source: Empirical Grid Baseline (Laplace alpha=1 or Tuned alpha=5)
P_grid_Empirical_Baseline.transformation: Normalised win rate by starting grid position from historical reference window
P_grid_Empirical_Baseline.availability_timestamp: Sunday ~2-3 hours before race start (Stage B)
